siteOptions.blogdescription: Playground demo for Duplicator – Backups & Migration Plugin

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// 0) MU plugin: intercept Duplicator's welcome redirect and send to Packages instead.
// MU plugins load before normal plugins and can hook earlier. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
if ( defined( 'WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR' ) ) {
    if ( ! is_dir( WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR ) ) {
        wp_mkdir_p( WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR );
    }
    $helper_path = WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR . '/duplicator-playground-helper.php';
    if ( ! file_exists( $helper_path ) ) {
        $helper_code  = "<?php\n";
        $helper_code .= "/*\n";
        $helper_code .= "Plugin Name: Duplicator Playground Helper\n";
        $helper_code .= "Description: Skip Duplicator's email opt-in welcome screen in Playground demos.\n";
        $helper_code .= "*/\n";
        $helper_code .= "add_filter('wp_redirect', function (\\$location, \\$status) {\n";
        $helper_code .= "    if (strpos(\\$location, 'page=duplicator-getting-started') !== false) {\n";
        $helper_code .= "        return admin_url('admin.php?page=duplicator');\n";
        $helper_code .= "    }\n";
        $helper_code .= "    return \\$location;\n";
        $helper_code .= "}, 1, 2);\n";
        file_put_contents( $helper_path, $helper_code );
    }
}

// 1) Create a simple site to back up / migrate.
$home_id = wp_insert_post([
  'post_title'   => 'Duplicator demo homepage',
  'post_name'    => 'duplicator-demo-home',
  'post_status'  => 'publish',
  'post_type'    => 'page',
  'post_content' => 'This is a WordPress Playground demo site for the Duplicator plugin. In a real workflow, this would be your source site. Use Duplicator → Packages → Create New to build a backup/migration package of this site.'
]);

if ( $home_id && ! is_wp_error( $home_id ) ) {
  update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
  update_option( 'page_on_front', $home_id );
}

wp_insert_post([
  'post_title'   => 'Demo article: Before migration',
  'post_status'  => 'publish',
  'post_type'    => 'post',
  'post_content' => 'Sample post for the Duplicator Playground demo. When you build a package, this content is included in the archive.'
]);

wp_insert_post([
  'post_title'   => 'Demo article: After migration checklist',
  'post_status'  => 'publish',
  'post_type'    => 'post',
  'post_content' => 'After restoring a Duplicator package on another host, you would verify pages, menus, and permalinks. This post just makes the package slightly more realistic.'
]);

// 2) Make sure the default storage dir exists and looks intentional.
// Duplicator Lite stores packages under wp-content/wp-snapshots by default. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
$storage_dir = trailingslashit( WP_CONTENT_DIR ) . 'wp-snapshots';
if ( ! file_exists( $storage_dir ) ) {
  wp_mkdir_p( $storage_dir );
}

$readme_path = $storage_dir . '/README-playground-demo.txt';
if ( ! file_exists( $readme_path ) ) {
  file_put_contents(
    $readme_path,
    "This is a WordPress Playground demo for the Duplicator plugin.\n" .
    "When you create a package from Duplicator → Packages, the archive and installer\n" .
    "will be written into this wp-snapshots directory.\n"
  );
}

// 3) Light-touch duplicator_settings note (harmless if the plugin ignores it).
$settings = get_option( 'duplicator_settings', [] );
$settings['playground_snapshots_path_note'] = $storage_dir;
update_option( 'duplicator_settings', $settings );
